title: HAProxy Ingress - AKS (Azure Managed Prometheus)
description: HAProxy Kubernetes Ingress Controller on AKS, metrics from the native HAProxy Prometheus exporter collected by Azure Managed Prometheus.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: HTTP requests per second received by the selected frontends.

panels.title: 5xx error rate
panels.description: Share of responses with 5xx status (generated by HAProxy or backends).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$frontend", code="5xx"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$frontend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0) * 100

panels.title: 4xx error rate
panels.description: Share of responses with 4xx status.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$frontend", code="4xx"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$frontend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0) * 100

panels.title: Avg response time
panels.description: Traffic-weighted average total time (queue + connect + response) over the last 1024 requests per backend.

targets.expr: (sum(haproxy_backend_total_time_average_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"} * rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.title: Connection saturation
panels.description: Worst pod: current connections vs global maxconn.

panels.title: HAProxy idle (min)
panels.description: Lowest idle-time across pods. Under 20% the HAProxy threads are CPU-saturated.

panels.title: Backends without servers
panels.description: Backends with zero active and backup servers: requests to them get 503.

targets.expr: count(max by (proxy) (haproxy_backend_active_servers{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"} + haproxy_backend_backup_servers{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Controller pods
panels.description: Pods currently exporting HAProxy metrics. Below 2 means no HA.

panels.title: Requests / s by frontend
panels.description: HTTP request rate per frontend.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Responses per second grouped by HTTP status class.

panels.title: Throughput (in / out)
panels.description: Bytes received from clients (up) and sent to clients (down).

panels.title: New connections / s by frontend
panels.description: Rate of new client connections accepted.

panels.title: Requests / s by pod
panels.description: Load distribution across controller replicas (should be roughly even).

panels.title: Current sessions by frontend
panels.description: Open client sessions per frontend.

panels.title: Top 10 backends by 5xx / s
panels.description: Backends returning the most 5xx responses.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (proxy) (rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend", code="5xx"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Top 10 backends by 5xx ratio
panels.description: 5xx as a share of each backend's responses.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (proxy) (rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend", code="5xx"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum by (proxy) (rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0) * 100 > 0)

panels.title: Backend errors / s
panels.description: Failed connections to pods, aborted/invalid responses, retries and redispatches.

panels.title: Frontend errors / denials / s
panels.description: Malformed requests, ACL/rate-limit denials and rejected connections.

panels.title: Latency breakdown (traffic-weighted avg)
panels.description: Average time spent in queue, connecting to the pod, waiting for the response, and total. HAProxy computes these over the last 1024 requests (no histograms available).

targets.expr: (sum(haproxy_backend_queue_time_average_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"} * rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

(sum(haproxy_backend_connect_time_average_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"} * rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

(sum(haproxy_backend_response_time_average_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"} * rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

(sum(haproxy_backend_total_time_average_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"} * rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(haproxy_backend_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.title: Top 10 slowest backends (avg total time)
panels.description: Backends with the highest average total time.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (proxy) (haproxy_backend_total_time_average_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}) > 0)

panels.title: Top 10 backends by max response time
panels.description: Worst total time observed since process start (resets on reload).

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (proxy) (haproxy_backend_max_total_time_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}) > 0)

panels.title: Backend queue (requests waiting)
panels.description: Requests waiting for a free server slot. Non-zero means pods are saturated (maxconn reached).

panels.title: Backend status (last 5m)
panels.description: One row per Kubernetes service backend. Sort by any column.

targets.expr: (sum by (proxy) (rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend", code="5xx"}[5m]))) / ((sum by (proxy) (rate(haproxy_backend_http_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[5m]))) > 0) * 100

panels.title: Health-check failures (top 10 servers)
panels.description: Failed health checks per backend server (pod endpoint).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (proxy, server) (increase(haproxy_server_check_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", proxy=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Active servers by backend
panels.description: Healthy endpoints per backend. Drops show pod failures or rollouts.

panels.title: Connections vs maxconn by pod
panels.description: Current connections per pod against the global maxconn.

panels.title: HAProxy idle time by pod
panels.description: Time HAProxy threads spend idle. Sustained values under 20% mean CPU saturation.

panels.title: Pod restarts (1h)
panels.description: Container restarts in the last hour (kube-state-metrics).

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[1h]))

panels.title: CPU usage by pod
panels.description: CPU cores used by controller pods (cAdvisor) with request/limit.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory working set by pod
panels.description: Memory working set (what the OOM killer looks at) with request/limit.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"})
